title: Phu Quoc and the Mekong in 7 days
summary: Phu Quoc, Chau Doc, Can Tho, and Ho Chi Minh City. November to April. The Phu Quoc to Chau Doc minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 1 — Phu Quoc
days.body: Fly in and stay on Long Beach.

days.title: Day 2 — Sao
days.body: Sao is half a day and free.

days.title: Day 3 — Toward Chau Doc
days.body: Leave the island. The minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 4 — Tra Su
days.body: Tra Su is half a day from town, 120,000 VND at the gate.

days.title: Day 6 — Cai Rang
days.body: Be at Cai Rang at dawn.

days.title: Day 7 — Ho Chi Minh City
days.body: Return to Ho Chi Minh City.
